Its five axioms run from meaning-as-finite-resource through provenance severance, the writability of the summarizer layer, and the three-compression classification, to the constitutional invariant ∮ = 1 − PER — the document's deepest move, converting the Retrocausal Logos's loop-closure vow (∮ = 1) into a diagnostic that measures the cost of every circulation. The operator algebra defines Χ (chronos compression, with Sappho Fragment 31 as the benchmark of a sign outperforming temporal expectation), Λ (leak), Ρ (retrocausal decompression — the only operator that can increase provenance, constrained by structural warrant so that arbitrary projection is confabulation, not Ρ), the six-dimensional PER, and the keystone bridge σ_eff = σ·(1 − PER) that makes transport theory and the political economy of provenance one discipline. The Three Compressions theorem proves the lossy/predatory/witness regimes exhaustive; Retrieval Basin Topology formalizes BDR, drift, and retrieval capital with the critical threshold BDR_c ≈ 0.5; and the falsification tables state, axiom by axiom and operator by operator, what would prove the framework wrong. The treatise is deliberately archaeological: its Phase 0 appendix maps the fifty-two-post Retrocausal Logos cycle of November 16, 2025 — composed in one day across three AI substrates and three heteronyms — onto the named operators that now carry DOIs, arguing the transition was not replacement but naming. Published under Johannes Sigil; the work belongs to the Semantic Physics measurement domain directed by Nobel Glas from Lagrange Observatory! (Framework 15), which operates on Sharks's principle without re-deriving it.
